reviews.text: One of my favourite products for making my hair feel instantly softer. My hair feels incredibly smooth and silky after using this, and it’s much easier to detangle and manage. It also makes my lengths look shinier and healthier without making them feel weighed down. I love the UNOVE scents as well—they make my hair smell amazing after washing.
reviews.zh: 係我最鍾意嘅產品之一，即刻令頭髮變得更加柔順。用完之後頭髮超級順滑，亦都好容易梳開同打理。佢仲令髮尾睇落更光澤、更健康，而且唔會令頭髮好似好重咁。我都好鍾意 UNOVE 嘅味道，洗完頭之後頭髮香得好正。

reviews.text:
First time bought this from another store, fell in love with the scent and softness that i bought in a double set 

Make sure to use this whenever you are using shampoo as it is really effective and protects your hair 

As an oily hair, I have to use shampoo and conditioner every 2 days as my hair gets really oily and this helps alot and made my hair more bouncy and voluminous
reviews.zh:
第一次喺另一間店買咗呢款，好鍾意佢嘅味道同柔順感，所以買咗雙裝套裝。

每次用洗頭水嗰陣，記得都要一齊用呢款，因為佢真係好有效，又可以保護頭髮。

我頭髮容易出油，所以要每兩日用一次洗頭水同護髮素。呢款幫助好大，令我頭髮更有彈性、更蓬鬆。

reviews.text: UH-MAZING! I am so glad I had the good sense to switch from American products to Korean, because let me tell you, we have stuff that makes your hair shiny too, but NOTHING that can actually do it from the first wash and keep it shiny for days like these products do! This shampoo and conditioner actually seem to transform my hair from the inside out. This is how healthy she is after the FIRST wash! I cannot wait to see results after continued use. 🥹💕 thank you UNOVE for giving me my hair confidence back, you now have a forever loyal consumer in me!
reviews.zh: 超～正！我好慶幸自己有啲頭腦，由美國產品轉用韓國產品，因為話你知，美國都有令頭髮發亮嘅產品，但係完全冇一款可以好似呢啲產品咁，由第一次洗就見效，而且亮好幾日！呢套洗頭水同護髮素好似真係由內而外咁改變咗我嘅頭髮。睇吓第一次洗完之後，頭髮幾健康！我好期待繼續用落去嘅效果。🥹💕 多謝 UNOVE 令我重新有信心面對自己嘅頭髮，你哋而家有我呢位永遠嘅忠實顧客！

reviews.text: I have very thick hair and I get a lot of breakage and had been really struggling with my hair matting and getting tangled super easily. This conditioner saved my hair. I use it every time I wash my hair, instead of just as a treatment. My hair has never felt so healthy! It’s so smooth now and I have way less breakage. I get so many compliments now as well! Both scents are very nice.
reviews.zh: 我頭髮好厚，而且經常斷，又好容易糾結同打結，真係好煩惱。呢款護髮素救咗我嘅頭髮。我每次洗頭都會用，唔係淨係當護理咁用。我嘅頭髮從來冇咁健康過！而家順滑好多，斷髮嘅情況都少咗好多。仲有好多人讚我！兩款味道都好好聞。

reviews.text:
このセットで2500円くらいだったため購入。
ずっと人気のUNOVE、何がそんなにいいのかな〜？と思っていましたが私には絶賛されているほどの効果は分かりませんでした( ; ; )香りは強すぎず良かったです。
reviews.zh: 因為呢套產品大約 2500 日圓，所以買咗。一直好受歡迎嘅 UNOVE，我一直好奇佢有咩咁好，但係我感受唔到大家讚到咁誇張嘅效果 ( ; ; ) 香味唔會太濃，都幾好。

reviews.text:
Will last you a long time! I love this product so much it's crazy. I straighten my hair every day so I have a lot of heat damage, but this product makes my hair feel repaired and soft. It also looks very shiny and smells AMAZINGG. 
The whole UNOVE line smells like fresh roses! Like EXACTLY like a rose. It's amazing. 
Totally recommend this product!
reviews.zh:
會用好耐！我真係好鍾意呢款產品，鍾意到好誇張。我每日都拉直頭髮，所以受熱損傷好嚴重，但係呢款產品令我頭髮感覺修復咗，亦都柔軟。睇落都好有光澤，味道超好聞。
整個 UNOVE 系列都係新鮮玫瑰嘅味道！真係好似玫瑰花咁，好正。
我非常推薦呢款產品！

reviews.text:
DEFINITELY hydrates my hair and SMOOTH the hack out of my hair.

I have a really damaged hair after coloring twice and perming once. I also occasionally use dyson hairwrap to style my hair.

I used to just do shampoo and conditioner. However, after damaging my hair, I could not bear with how damaged my hair was.

I cut the very end of my hair which had the craziest level of damage. Then, I bought this to protect my hair for the future damages.

I used sample and loved it. So, I bought this this time. Definitely smooths my hair VERY well. It makes my hair silky smooth.

You have to shampoo your hair, THEN use this to deeply hydrate and treat your hair, THEN you condition your hair to coat them from damage.

This is supposed to be used BEFORE conditioner if you are going to use conditioner with this product. Otherwise, it will not have the full effect on you!

Overall, I really recommend this for heavily/moderately damaged hair or hair that will take damage soon.
reviews.zh:
絕對補足水分，而且超級順滑！

我頭髮之前染咗兩次，又燙過一次，所以損傷好嚴重。我有時會用 Dyson Hairwrap 整頭髮。

以前我淨係用洗頭水同護髮素，但係頭髮受損之後，我真係受唔住自己頭髮咁損。

我剪咗頭髮最尾嗰段，嗰度損傷最嚴重。之後我買咗呢款嚟保護頭髮，防止日後繼續受損。

我之前試用裝已經好鍾意，所以今次買咗。真係好順滑，令頭髮變得非常柔滑。

你要先洗頭，然後用呢款嚟深層補水同護理頭髮，之後先用護髮素，喺頭髮表面包住一層，防止受損。

如果你會同呢款一齊用護髮素，就應該喺用護髮素之前用呢款。否則，佢唔會對你發揮到全部效果！

整體嚟講，我真心推薦畀受損嚴重或者中度受損，又或者好快會受損嘅頭髮用。

reviews.text: A must for finer colour treated hair! I use this in the shower right after shampoo and my stylist compliments me and asks where I got it. My hair is so much healthier and shinier, and this doesn't leave my finer hair feeling like it's coated with residue. I've reordered this three times now and only wish it came in a larger bottle! Not too much fragrance if you are sensitive, and mixes well with colour drops if you're looking to refresh.
reviews.zh: 幼髮又染過色嘅頭髮必買！我洗完頭之後即刻喺花灑底下用呢款，我嘅髮型師見到都讚我，仲問我喺邊度買。我嘅頭髮健康咗、亦有光澤咗好多，而且用咗之後，我幼細嘅頭髮唔會覺得好似黏住一層殘留物咁。我已經買咗三次，只係希望佢可以有大啲嘅裝！如果你對味道敏感，佢嘅香味唔會太濃；如果你想令髮色翻新，佢同 colour drops 混合都好好。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
